name: Crantock Beach Holiday Park
accommodation: Self-catering caravans, including sea-view and dog-friendly caravans
dogs: Dog-friendly caravans; direct access to dog-friendly beach walks
beachAccess: About a five-minute stroll to Crantock Beach (Visit Cornwall)
confirmedFeatures: Bar and restaurant, takeaway, shop, laundrette, swimming pool, adventure golf, playground, arcade, kids clubs, Wi-Fi
overview: A Parkdean Resorts holiday park above Crantock, looking out to sea and about five minutes' walk from the beach. It offers self-catering caravans, some with sea views and some dog friendly. Facilities include a pool, bar, restaurant, shop and kids clubs.
surfTripFit: A family base within walking distance of Crantock Beach, with Fistral just across the Gannel.
